Jared wants direct PM integration of `https://github.com/vava-nessa/free-coding-models`, substantial PM-specific modification, automatic upstream update intake because the maintainer continuously changes providers/settings, app-launch plus daily configurable Auto Apply checks, quiet notification/inbox summaries for successful validated imports, blocking review for quarantined/unsafe changes, all free models listed under one PM direct provider called `Free Models`, a GUI comments link to the upstream GitHub repo, quota/usage monitoring, PM-wide top-10 user-prioritized provider/model failover across all providers/models including enabled costed/metered/paid-overage/credit-consuming entries, editable starter global top-10 suggestions, outside-top-10 fallback when all prioritized entries fail, PM-wide refresh for models from all providers including `inluding direct and cli(not just free)`, a manual refresh button near model settings, catalog/model metadata only as the default manual/all-provider refresh depth, automatic runtime behavior changes including deeper/synthesized adapter behavior for Free Models as long as they adapt to PM structure, non-consuming structural/contract verification by default, automatic rollback/quarantine for bad Free Models updates, latest/default-branch upstream tracking with pin/rollback controls, PM credential/account reuse for Free Models entries, guided setup for missing credentials, Free Models catalog visible by default with ready-only routing, downgraded non-free entries leaving active Free Models while preserving history, Free Models catalog grouping/filtering/badges, no technical import-diff/history as the normal user UI, Advanced/Support-only technical diagnostics, plain-language update/status/availability/fallback language for non-developer vibe coders, a simple `Use Free Models when possible` preset/toggle with advanced customization, configurable budget presets, native integration rather than Docker, and Hybrid behavior for Auto Apply invalidated priority slots. Jared also prefers multiple questions at once instead of one-at-a-time during planning. Jared later answered q-0032 through q-0035 with opt-in preset activation, paid-provider-first default precedence unless user top-10 order places Free Models above paid providers/models, automatic post-guided-setup refresh/suggestion updates, global preset scope with advanced overrides, and future onboarding/doctor sequencing where paid providers are set up before Free Models top-10 configuration. Jared later answered q-0036 through q-0039 with `Yes to all 4`, accepting Auto Apply catalog/suggestion additions without silent top-10 reorder, PM-owned adapter revisions for automatic runtime behavior changes, friendly plus underlying Free Models Usage attribution, and unsupported upstream additions shown as unavailable/needs app support. Plans docs were reviewed for Models_System, Prompt_Pipeline, Goal_Runtime_System, FinalGUISpec, Multi-Account, Orchestrator Interviewer config, and Assistant Chat model/runtime disclosure before recording the override correction.
